load_state_dict_model: load a PyTorch model's state dict from a pre-trained checkpoint with automatic prefix stripping and key alignment
align_and_update_state_dicts: align and update a model's state dict keys by suffix-matching against a loaded pre-trained state dict
strip_prefix_if_present: strip a given prefix from all keys in a state dict if every key starts with that prefix
review_align_and_update_state_dicts: review the align_and_update_state_dicts function that matches model weights by longest suffix match strategy
summarize_load_state_dict: summarize the load_state_dict function that strips module prefixes and aligns state dicts before loading into a model
